uid_decisions.wmo_decision: Two source records in36_25 and36_26: same path, UID, position, rotation, flags and sets. Only minZ and maxX bounds differ. Existing36_25 bounds contain36_26 bounds; retain the conservative36_25 representation for every reference, with no transform changes.
uid_decisions.distinct_decision: Native bush and source tree have different paths, positions, rotation and scale. Keep native UID; allocate source identity a free UID after exhaustive map0 native/source probing. Rewrite every occurrence of that exact source identity only.

adaptations.materials: Unused MTEX/MTXF removed, no aliases. Surviving alpha bytes retained; MCLY/MCAL and predominant indices rebuilt.
adaptations.liquids: Same-side MH2O layers authoritative; legacy flags0x3c and offset/size zero only in cells with MH2O layers. Opaque MCLQ bytes retained; legacy-only cells unchanged.

limitations: No client render/swimming/collision test or server extraction.
All MH2O layers preserved; current AzerothCore extractor reads only the first layer.
UID audit covers the specified native/source map0 snapshots, not arbitrary playing-client patches.
Asset conversion/namespace closure and DBC installation are separate outputs, not certified here.
Native MFBO retained tile-wide; no flight-boundary redesign.
Inherited source cracks are not repaired.
